title: Pilot photo of ARV over Provo

tellings.quote: He has an image taken by a pilot Harvey something I can't quite remember over Provo Utah right by Dougway proving grounds in the 60s

plain: In the 1960s a pilot named Harvey is said to have photographed an ARV, short for 'alien reproduction vehicle', a craft said to be a human-built copy of alien technology. He took the picture over Provo, Utah, near the Dugway Proving Ground, a military test range. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels that a man named Mark McCandlish has the image. He cannot remember the pilot's surname.
